title: role-cycles.config.json
description: The canonical role-cycle declaration per pipeline, read by scripts/agent-doc-check's check 4. Each cycle's `roles` array is rendered to the canonical arrow string by the checker itself -- the config carries arrays, never arrow strings, so the glyph and spacing have exactly one author. The role roster stays derived from the agent files; the checker validates each declared role against it. Adding a pipeline's cycle is a config-only diff by design.
